name: Market Summary

inputs.name: canonicalScope
inputs.meaning: Existing authenticated capability/population, transaction, canonical geography/type and explicit customer selection; source-qualified identities stay distinct.
inputs.unit: canonical IDs and scope / IDs y ámbito canónicos
inputs.missingBehavior: Deny/unavailable; never widen scope / denegar/no disponible; nunca ampliar ámbito

inputs.name: canonicalEvidence
inputs.meaning: Current eligible Private or Bank observations through existing canonical readers and provenance; Bank direct-sale/lifecycle/raw transaction evidence is required, not appraisal.
inputs.missingBehavior: Missing/inconsistent acquisition is unavailable or excluded with explicit reason; not a successful empty market / adquisición ausente/incoherente no disponible o exclusión explícita; no mercado vacío exitoso

calculationStages.meaning: Acquire only currently authorized canonical evidence; reject incomplete, incoherent or out-of-scope inputs.
Apply the existing engine-specific eligibility, normalization and formula sequence below; preserve every non-established state.
Return source/release-bound evidence through existing guards; methodology retrieval itself never runs the engine or charges execution.

question: How many current eligible listings belong to this explicitly selected market?
applications: Buyers and agents can assess the size of the observable offering before interpreting more selective numerical cohorts.

formulas.denominator: None: integer addition / ninguna: suma entera
formulas.normalization: Canonical source identity / identidad canónica de origen
formulas.precisionAndRounding: IEEE754 binary64; analytical values not display-rounded / valores analíticos sin redondeo de presentación. No additional rounding or inferential precision claimed / sin redondeo adicional ni precisión inferencial afirmada.

population.definition: Current observable eligible listings/asking market within the explicit source-qualified scope, not historical transactions. Private and Bank results remain separate; only the existing adapter branches explicitly exposing crossMarket support a cross-market calculation.
eligibility: Current observable eligible listings/asking market within the explicit source-qualified scope, not historical transactions. Private and Bank results remain separate; only the existing adapter branches explicitly exposing crossMarket support a cross-market calculation.

Except matching/configuration, adapter selected preference groups must positively match (any selected value within a group, all selected groups). Matching ranks evidence; configuration counts its full conjunction against the base.

Sale and monthly Rent never mix. Bank canonical reduction requires DIRECT_SALE, exact retained sale transaction, PUBLISHED lifecycle, valid source freshness/provenance and coherent geography/type; Bank rent is not fabricated.
Nonnegative safe integer inputs; zero is an established empty count. No statistical minimum.
exclusions: Missing, contradictory, invalid, unconfirmed or stale required evidence cannot become zero, a guessed value or a silently widened population.
No exact area from category/range; no construction-as-footprint; asking amounts are not realized transactions; canonical money identities and BCCR date remain explicit.

outputs.name: n/saleCount/rentCount
outputs.meaning: Inventory count and separate transaction counts
outputs.interpretation: Counts describe this scope; the adapter supplies one transaction at a time.

resultStates.empty: An established empty selected population has zero count and undefined numerical summaries; retain the engine-specific states below.
resultStates.zero: Zero counts and zero valid differences/IQR may be meaningful; zero/negative asking price or normalization area is not an eligible positive observation.
resultStates.invalid: Invalid input, contradictory identity, duplicate canonical evidence or mixed scope follows the existing throw/exclusion branch; no invented successful result.
resultStates.unavailable: Missing authority, current rights, coherent source snapshot, required FX or subject is unavailable/denied under existing guards; never a successful empty substitute.
resultStates.undefined: N=0→EMPTY_POPULATION; positive N→ESTABLISHED; negative/non-integer count throws. Each input must be a safe integer; combined-sum safe-integer overflow is not separately checked in the pure helper.

supportedInterpretation: Buyers and agents can assess the size of the observable offering before interpreting more selective numerical cohorts.
unsupportedInterpretations: What was the realized sale price, historical appreciation, causal return, forecast or guaranteed investment outcome? These are not established by this current asking-market engine.
No area or price is required for inventory counting; a count is not an estimate of value or demand.
